card.text: The Helix is a planetary nebula about 216 parsecs away.

sources.label: Benedict et al. (2009), HST parallaxes of planetary nebula nuclei

introduction.text: The Helix is a planetary nebula about 216 parsecs away. Its broad ring of glowing gas surrounds the remnant central star.

sources.label: Benedict et al. (2009), HST parallaxes of planetary nebula nuclei

rings.title: Helix on its two rings
rings.summary: The photograph on the nebula's two published rings: an inner disc and the outer ring around it, each at its own tilt.
